heroDescription: CHRONO is a destination for fine timepieces, where timeless design meets personal style.
storyImageAlt: A luxury wristwatch on a dark surface
storyP1: CHRONO was created from a simple belief: a watch is more than a tool for telling time. It is a companion that carries memories, milestones and personality.
storyP2: We carefully curate every piece in our collection, choosing watches for their design, craftsmanship and lasting character rather than passing trends.
storyP3: From classic icons to modern statements, our goal is to help you find the timepiece that feels unmistakably yours.

design.title: Timeless Design
design.description: We choose watches that stay elegant for years, not just for a season.

authenticity.title: Guaranteed Authenticity
authenticity.description: Every timepiece is carefully selected and verified before it reaches you.

service.title: Personal Service
service.description: Our team is here to guide you from the first question to the final choice.

ctaTitle: Find the Watch That Tells Your Story
ctaDescription: Explore the collection and discover a timepiece made to be worn and remembered.
